blocks.text: Mastering legal document formatting on Mac

Legal document formatting is the backbone of your daily output. Whether you work with pleadings, contracts, or correspondence, the requirements for margins, fonts, and numbering are strict. Microsoft Word for Mac remains the industry standard for these tasks. You likely spend hours adjusting styles, managing track changes, and ensuring every document meets court filing standards.

When you need to change a style or find a specific formatting tool, your hands often leave the keyboard. This breaks your flow. With Lazur, you can hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about any formatting option. Lazur points at the menu item, saving you the time spent searching through the ribbon.
Reducing administrative burden in legal support

Legal secretaries often report that nearly half of their day disappears into administrative tasks. This includes tracking billable hours, managing calendars for court appearances, and responding to client emails. The pressure to maintain accuracy while working quickly is high. When you use your voice to dictate routine emails or set reminders, you gain back time for more complex work.

Dictation allows you to draft clear, formatted text directly into your documents or email clients. Hold the fn key to start speaking. This is particularly useful for long-form correspondence where typing speed might otherwise slow you down. Always ensure you are following your firm's compliance rules regarding client data before using any dictation feature.

Locating files across fragmented systems is a common pain point. You might have documents stored in a document management system, local folders, and email attachments. Spending hours each week searching for these files is inefficient. Instead of clicking through Finder windows, use your voice to ask about file locations or status.

blocks.text: Your role as a legal secretary involves handling sensitive client information. All your work must comply with your employer's rules. Never upload confidential client data to external tools unless explicitly authorized by your firm. Lazur processes your voice and screen data locally on your Mac, but you must remain vigilant about the content you interact with during your workday.
How to speed up your daily workflow

Efficiency in a legal office comes down to how you manage your tools. If you use Outlook for email, use keyboard shortcuts to navigate folders. If you use Word, learn the specific shortcuts for track changes and comment insertion. When you get stuck, ask Lazur to point out the button or guide you through a complex task.
